fields.claim: Aramid cores use their thickness-direction CTE in plane, a measured Nomex wall modulus with paper density and strength, a projected Kevlar fabric wall, and a minimum shear strength scaled from CR-III's ratio. They do not float because crimping binds, which none of these changes; without drying credit their water also breaks the service pressure.
fields.needed_to_ground: In-plane CTE and wall data for low-density aramid cores.
